sloka: आसनानि यथा न्यायम् आर्याणाम् विशताम् तदा ।अदृश्यत घन अपाये पूर्ण चन्द्रा इव शर्वरी ॥२-८२-२॥
transliteration: āsanāni yathā nyāyam āryāṇām viśatām tadā ।adṛśyata ghana apāye pūrṇa candrā iva śarvarī ॥2-82-2॥

translations.english: When the seats were occupied by the honourable members according to their rank, that august assembly looked splendid with the brilliance of their apparels and fragrance of unguents.
